Title: SMILES transformer descriptor
Description: Turns a SMILES string into 1,024 features using a Transformer pretrained without labels on 861,000 molecules sampled from ChEMBL. Honda and colleagues framed pretraining as sequence reconstruction, so the encoder learns chemistry from raw strings rather than from curated descriptors, and found the fingerprint most valuable where downstream labelled data are scarce. The served code never switches the network to evaluation mode, so dropout stays active and the same molecule yields slightly different vectors on every run.
Interpretation: 1024 features encoding molecular structure from a self-supervised SMILES Transformer.
